fullSampleGuards.yearScore: no lower on observed or simulated climate at confirmation
fullSampleGuards.peakWithinMonth: no more than one gauge worse per climate
fullSampleGuards.greatBasinAbsMeanPhase: no worse than baseline plus one discrete month/great-gauge-count
fullSampleGuards.coldPeakWithinMonth: at most one cold gauge worse
fullSampleGuards.coldFloodFractionError: at most one cold gauge worse

notes: These are operational acceptance criteria, not a claim of physical validation.
Validation split is fixed before looking at search results.
Unchanged annual flows, geometry, matching, zero counts and data source are required.
If speed alone is insufficient, screen baseflow fractions 0.6,0.65,0.7,0.75 and storage times 2,2.5,3,3.5 months around the promising speeds; report that extension.
Holdout at a new terrain resolution is not an independent observed time period.
